instructions: Put a medium pot of water with 1 tsp salt on high heat. Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1/2-inch cubes.
Add the potatoes to the boiling water and cook for 3 minutes, until they're only slightly tender. Drain them well.
Meanwhile, dice the onion, mince the garlic, and slice the jalapeño for the table.
Heat the 3 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the potatoes and 1/2 tsp salt. Cook for 8 minutes, turning now and then, until they're golden and crisp at the edges.
Add the onion and cook for 2 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until you can smell it.
Whisk the 6 eggs with 1/4 tsp salt and the pepper in a bowl. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave.
Pour the eggs into the skillet and stir gently with the potatoes. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the eggs are set but still soft.
Fill the warm tortillas with the potatoes and eggs. Serve with the sliced jalapeño at the table.
method_notes: No version found has 20 ratings, so this leads with Maricruz Avalos's papas con huevo, which boils the cubes for 3 minutes before crisping them in oil. Mama Maggie's (5 from 4 votes) steams the potatoes in the pan instead, and Adan Medrano boils them 5 minutes and serves in flour tortillas. Six eggs from Mama Maggie's, since this is a taco filling for 4; the jalapeño moves from the pan to the table to keep the base mild; corn tortillas keep it gluten-free.
